note: Zero-infrastructure default: consoles read the published updates/saves.json index and submit new saves through a prefilled GitHub issue (SPEC §17.22.5). Switch to the Supabase backend by replacing this object with the '_example' below (minus the leading underscore keys) or by filling Settings → Saves → Backend on the console; both backends can be active at once and the lists are merged.

_example._about: The anon key is public by design (row-level security limits what it can do). Deploy the schema and the edge functions from xeno-store/backend/supabase/ first; the console lists rows from public.ps5_save_collection, downloads through signed URLs or the garlic-savedb function and uploads to the bucket.
